pixel_metrics.pro_aupro_note: Not calculated; no validated PRO implementation is included.

summary.evaluation_protocol: PatchCore trained on train/good; 20 test/good images calibrate defects; each normal test image uses leave-one-out calibration.
summary.external_image_results: No external image set is included; uploaded examples are single-case demonstrations, not generalization evidence.
summary.calibration_source: dataset/bottle/test/good; held out from PatchCore training
summary.decision_metric_semantics: Only DEFECT counts as an automatic positive; UNCERTAIN and MANUAL REVIEW REQUIRED are non-positive outcomes and are counted in the confusion-matrix false-negative cell for defective ground truth.
